patterns.name: Two Pointers (Inward Squeeze & Fast/Slow)
patterns.signature: Sorted array or linked list, searching for pair sums, boundaries, or cycle detection with O(1) space.
keyInsights: Inward squeeze: left=0, right=n-1; move left if sum < target, right if sum > target.
Floyd cycle finding: slow moves 1 step, fast moves 2 steps; collision implies cycle.

patterns.name: Sliding Window (Dynamic & Fixed)
patterns.signature: Continuous subarray or substring satisfying constraint (longest, shortest, exact sum, unique characters).
patterns.dataStructure: Two pointers (left, right) + Frequency Map / Set
keyInsights: Expand right pointer to include elements until constraint violated.
Shrink left pointer to restore invariant while updating optimal answer.
Each element entered and exited at most once -> O(2N) = O(N).

patterns.name: Monotonic Stack (Next Greater / Smaller)
patterns.signature: Need nearest larger or smaller element to left/right, histogram area, stock span.
patterns.dataStructure: Stack maintaining strictly increasing or decreasing order
keyInsights: Next Greater Element: maintain monotonic decreasing stack of indices.
Pop elements from stack whenever current element is strictly larger.
Each index pushed and popped at most once.

patterns.name: Binary Search on Answer Space
patterns.signature: Monotonic feasibility function: if answer X works, all Y >= X also work (or vice versa). "Minimize maximum" or "Maximize minimum".
keyInsights: Define valid range [low, high] for the target capacity, speed, or distance.
Evaluate mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2) with helper function.
Narrow search space based on monotonic check.

patterns.name: Topological Sort (Kahn's Algorithm & Cycle Detection)
patterns.signature: Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) with prerequisites, dependency resolution, course scheduling.
keyInsights: Compute in-degree for every vertex; enqueue vertices with in-degree 0.
While queue not empty, pop u, add to order, decrement in-degree of all neighbors.
If neighbor in-degree reaches 0, enqueue it. If processed count < V, cycle detected!

patterns.name: 0/1 Knapsack & Subset Sum Space Optimization
patterns.signature: Choosing subset of items with given weights/values to maximize value under capacity W (each item used at most once).
patterns.dataStructure: 1D DP array traversed in reverse direction
keyInsights: State: dp[w] = maximum value achievable with capacity w.
Reverse loop: for w = W down to itemWeight, so previous state represents i-1.
Base case: dp[0] = 0; all other dp[w] = 0 (or -infinity if exact sum required).

patterns.name: Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) & String DP
patterns.signature: Comparison, alignment, edit distance, or commonality between two sequences A and B.
patterns.dataStructure: 2D DP grid dp[i][j] (or two 1D rows for space optimization)
keyInsights: State: dp[i][j] = LCS of prefix A[0..i-1] and B[0..j-1].
Transition: If A[i-1] == B[j-1]: dp[i][j] = 1 + dp[i-1][j-1].
Else: dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]).
Base cases: dp[i][0] = 0 and dp[0][j] = 0.
